title: polypodium penangianum
intro: Polypodium penangianum, commonly known as the Penang Polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and inflammation. The health benefits of Polypodium penangianum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to promote wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents responsible for these therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
